name: Sepehr UI
author: Parya Rastegar

sections.description:
Sepehr UI gives Elementor a consistent, modern look. Pick your colors once, and every widget, page and post follows them, in light and dark mode.

  • 22 widgets: Hero, Section Heading, Feature Grid, Projects, Photo Mosaic, Card, Button, Badge, Alert, Accordion with FAQ data, Tabs, Stats, Steps, Testimonials, Logo Cloud, Team, Call to Action, Contact Info, Social Links, Recent posts, Logo and Dark Mode Toggle.
  • Design tokens driven by Elementor Site Settings: Global Colors, plus a Design System tab for corners, shadows and the dark palette.
  • Appearance → Customize → Sepehr: every color, fonts, corners and shadows, with live preview.
  • 3 presets and 2 starter sites with translatable sample content.
  • Light, dark and system color modes without flashing.
  • Any language, left to right or right to left. Bundled fonts load from your own server; Google Fonts stay available.
  • Works with any theme, including the free Sepehr theme.

Sepehr Pro is a separate plugin that adds forms, a menu widget, header and footer templates, a slider, live search and more. Learn more at https://technello.com/sepehr

External services

Starter site photos are not included in the plugin, to keep it small. When an administrator imports a starter site, the plugin downloads that starter’s photos from https://www.technello.com/sepehr/starter-media/ and adds them to the Media Library. Nothing else happens in the background.

  • What is sent: an ordinary download request for each photo, which carries your server’s IP address and WordPress’s user agent. No site content, user data or settings are sent.
  • When: only while a starter site is being imported.
  • Who runs it: TechNello B.V., the author of this plugin. Privacy policy: https://www.technello.com/privacy-policy

Developers can serve the photos from elsewhere with the sepehr_ui/starter_media_url filter.

Credits

Starter site photos (downloaded during an import): StockSnap, CC0; photographers and sources are listed in credits.json in each starter folder, e.g. https://www.technello.com/sepehr/starter-media/v1/corporate/credits.json
shadcn/ui (MIT, https://ui.shadcn.com), Lucide (ISC, https://lucide.dev), Simple Icons (CC0, https://simpleicons.org), Embla Carousel (MIT, https://www.embla-carousel.com), Tailwind CSS palette values (MIT, https://tailwindcss.com).
Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1: Inter, Manrope, Lora, Vazirmatn, Estedad, Lalezar, Gloock, Hanken Grotesk, Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans, Fraunces, Figtree, Archivo, Young Serif, Cormorant, Instrument Serif, Libre Caslon Text (licence files in assets/build/fonts).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Open the Sepehr menu to apply a preset or import a starter site.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Everything here works with free Elementor.

Does the plugin contact other servers?

Only when you import a starter site: its photos are downloaded from technello.com into your Media Library. See External services below. Elementor can load Google Fonts; you can turn that off from the Sepehr page when you apply a preset. The fonts that come with the plugin load from your own site.

Is the code available?

The readable source of the minified CSS and JavaScript is in the src folder, with the build scripts. To rebuild them, run npm install and then npm run build in that folder.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Both starters redesigned with their own type, colors and photography: Northbound, a studio site, and Margin, a weekly magazine.
  • New widgets: Projects and Photo Mosaic. Team and Logo Cloud are now in the free plugin.
  • Hero: cover layout, kicker, image shape, arch frame and caption. Feature Grid: list rows, numbered. Team: duotone, black and white or arched photos. Button: stays at the bottom of the screen on phones.
  • Highlighted words can be italic, a marker underline or the secondary color; rating stars follow the brand color.
  • Seven more bundled typefaces: Fraunces, Figtree, Archivo, Young Serif, Cormorant, Instrument Serif and Libre Caslon Text.
  • WordPress global styles (blog posts, archives) now follow the site’s colors and fonts.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
